properties.state: {"description":"dec:null-unsets-on-every-typed-constructor (Anthony 2026-10-24, \"null unsets everywhere\"), extending the 2026-09-07 create_node rule (chg:eight-field-feedback-fixes-land-for-v0510). Every add_* constructor, plan_epoch and record_finding take their request as Nullable<T>, which keeps the names of the fields sent as an explicit null and publishes T's schema unchanged. After the constructor's own writes, under the call's one write unit: a null on an optional property removes it (a property with a schema default reads its default again, as at create_node; add_inference's computed name likewise) and the reply lists it under `unset`; a null on a schema-required property, or on one the constructor needs to create the node (RequiredFields::refuse_nulled: DesignEpoch.sequence, TemporalFact.statement), is refused by name and nothing is written; a null on a parameter that is not a stored property (an edge, approver, echo) means what leaving it out means. Code: crates/reflow2-mcp/src/nulls.rs, RequiredFields in service.rs, and each constructor in tools/{capture,assure,built,operate_tools,temporal_tools}.rs.","name":"A null unsets a field at every typed constructor, and a field left out keeps its value","provenance":"authored","status":"realized"}
